svg.title: Flow figure: Order a cake, Get the cake, Delivery zone?, Too far, In stock?, Sold out, Bake, Drive. Steps: Delivered, Sold out, Too far.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Order a cake, Get the cake, Delivery zone?, Too far, In stock?, Sold out, Bake, Drive. Delivered. The customer orders a cake in the app. The address is in the delivery zone. The cake is in stock, so the bakery bakes it. The bakery hands the boxed cake to the courier. The courier drives the cake to the door. Sold out. The customer orders a cake in the app. The address is in the delivery zone. The cake is sold out, so the bakery refuses the order. Too far. The customer orders a cake for an address far away. The address is outside the delivery zone, so the bakery refuses.

g.text: The customer orders a cake in the app.
The address is in the delivery zone.
The cake is in stock, so the bakery bakes it.
The bakery hands the boxed cake to the courier.
The courier drives the cake to the door.
The cake is sold out, so the bakery refuses the order.
The customer orders a cake for an address far away.
The address is outside the delivery zone, so the bakery refuses.
